_readme: Shown as a small card on Ascend's Home screen (app 1.0.2+), one at a time, in order; users can dismiss each by id. Fields: id (unique, never reuse), title, body, optional button + url (https:// or market://, opens in the browser / Play Store). Optional per-item rules: onlyBelow (e.g. "1.0.3" = only versions older than that), onlyFrom (e.g. "1.0.2" = only that version or newer), expires ("YYYY-MM-DD", hidden from that day). Leave the rules out to show an item to everyone.
